job_description:
**Job Purpose:**

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against.

You won’t manage engineers — you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements.
* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Opportunity identification and value sizing**

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

**Engineering partnership and enablement**

* Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on.
* Run engagement structure end-to-end — scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways — drafted, agreed, and revisited.
* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

**Stakeholder alignment and communication**

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

**Measurement, learning, and iteration**

* Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front.
* Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement.

**Required Skills:**

* 15+ years of professional experience with bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as R&D, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground.
* Technical fluency in modern AI/ML — enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Strong individual contributor instincts — you produce quality artefacts, not status updates.

**Preferred Skills**:

  

* Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT).
* Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, the ML lifecycle, and evaluation patterns, with the ability to assess data readiness (availability, quality, access constraints, and labelling) before engineering starts.
* Understanding of how GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shape AI deployments in pharma — and how to factor them into scoping without over-constraining engineering.
* Experience producing value cases with clear assumptions and sensitivity ranges, and maintaining an opportunity portfolio with clear rationale for what is in flight, queued, or de-prioritised.
* Product intuition: a clear understanding of the difference between an MVP, a product, and a platform, and the ability to spot patterns that should become shared capabilities.
* An AI-native way of working — codifying product management and user research best practices into reusable skills, plugins, and markdown files, and using the command line to automate everyday tasks.
* Ability to lead through influence and write crisp, outcome-focused communications that connect progress to the value case.
* Experience running honest retrospectives that distinguish execution failures from selection failures.

**Skills**

Agentic Platforms, Global Supply Chain, Global Supply Chain Strategy, Pharmaceutical Supply Chain, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Principal Product Manager
job_description:
**Principal Product Manager – Post Purchase & Returns**

**About us:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Guest Experience organization. Target is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our business objectives, guest segments and behaviors, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target.

The **Post Purchase & Returns Product team** is responsible for creating seamless, reliable, and differentiated guest experiences after an order is placed. The team builds capabilities across order tracking, fulfillment, order modifications, payments, returns, and refunds, enabling greater transparency, convenience, and control for guests. Through platform modernization, intelligent automation, and innovative digital experiences, we strive to simplify complex post-purchase journeys, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen guest trust and loyalty.

**About the role:**

This **Principal Product Manager – Post Purchase & Returns** role will be based in Target in India (TII) and will serve as a senior individual contributor, driving product strategy and execution for critical capabilities within Target's post-purchase ecosystem in close partnership with leaders and teams across Target.

As Principal Product Manager, you will define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for complex post-purchase capabilities, translating guest needs, business priorities, and technology opportunities into scalable solutions. You will drive meaningful improvements in guest experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes while ensuring products meet enterprise standards for reliability, usability, and scalability.

You will lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple business and technology teams, partnering with senior leaders across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, and Guest Services to align priorities, navigate trade-offs, and remove execution barriers. You will influence decisions across interconnected products and platforms, balancing long-term strategic investments with near-term business needs.

You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, leveraging guest insights, analytics, experimentation, and competitive intelligence to validate opportunities and inform product decisions. You will establish clear goals and OKRs, assess product health and financial impact, and use data-driven insights to prioritize investments and deliver measurable outcomes.

You will partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to modernize foundational platforms, improve system reliability, and identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to simplify post-purchase experiences and operations.

As a senior individual contributor, you will serve as a product thought leader, influencing product direction across teams, mentoring product managers, and elevating product management practices through expertise, collaboration, and strategic influence rather than direct people management.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of product management experience, including experience leading complex, enterprise-scale digital products.
* Proven experience defining product strategy and roadmaps and driving measurable business outcomes across complex product ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce, retail, order management, fulfillment, or post-purchase experiences, including order tracking, modifications, cancellations, returns, and refunds.
* Demonstrated ability to lead highly complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple business and technology teams, navigating ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams to build scalable, reliable platforms and modernize legacy technology ecosystems.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to evaluate guest experience, operational efficiency, financial impact, and return on investment to inform product decisions.
* Expertise in product discovery, experimentation, analytics, and data-driven decision-making, with a strong ability to define OKRs and measure product success.
* Strong communication and executive presence, with a proven track record of influencing senior leaders and driving alignment across large enterprise organizations.
* Expertise in agile product development, including iterative delivery, prioritization, user stories, and working with cross-functional scrum teams.
* Strategic mindset and bias for action, with the ability to balance long-term product vision with near-term execution and business priorities.
* Ability to identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, including AI and automation, to improve guest experiences and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor product managers, elevate product thinking, and drive strategic influence without formal people management authority.
* Strong ability to build relationships and collaborate across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Guest Services, and Target in India.

**Know More About Us here:**

* **Life at Target**: https://india.target.com/
* **Benefits**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging
* **Target** **Tech**: https://tech.target.com/

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform**

  

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.

Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.

You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.

**What You Will Own**

**The search and query platform.** Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.

**Federated analytics.** Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.

**Customer context and the knowledge graph.** Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.

**Data discovery and shared context services.** Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
* Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
* The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
* Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
* **Data correctness and trust.** Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.

**Federated analytics.** Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.

**Customer context and the knowledge graph.** Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.

**Data discovery and shared context services.** Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
* Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
* The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
* Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
* **Data correctness and trust.** Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

job_description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

**InMobi Advertising**

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

**Glance**

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

**About Accelerate:**  
Accelerate is InMobi's AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate's agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.  
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. The product team is organized by capability, not segment. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager, alongside Customer Experience Core (campaign creation, onboarding and activation).  
  
**About the role:**  
You will build Accelerate's payments and money infrastructure from zero. Every dollar or rupee an advertiser puts into Accelerate flows through what you build: how they fund their account, how spend is drawn down across ad platforms, how they are invoiced, refunded and taxed, and how we settle with suppliers.  
There is no legacy system to inherit. You will define the wallet, the ledger behind it, and the integration with our third-party payments partner (Vyre), then own the revenue metrics that depend on them. Getting this right is what lets an SMB go from signup to live campaign in minutes, and what lets finance trust every number on the dashboard.  
You will work with a Senior Product Associate on the pod, engineering, Central Design, and InMobi finance, tax and legal teams.

**What you will own:**

* Advertiser wallet. A prepaid balance advertisers top up and Accelerate draws down as campaigns spend. Includes funding methods, auto-recharge, low-balance alerts, credit lines for larger accounts, and the rules for how a balance can and cannot be used.
* Ledger and reconciliation. The source of truth for every credit, debit, hold, refund and adjustment. Spend reported by each ad platform must reconcile to the ledger, with clear handling for mismatches.
* Payments integration. End-to-end integration with Vyre, our third-party payments partner: collections, payment methods, failures and retries, webhooks, and the fallback plan if a provider is down.
* Billing, invoicing and tax. Invoices, receipts, GST, TDS on ad spend, and multi-currency handling as we add international advertisers.
* Supplier settlement. How we pay out and reconcile with ad platforms, working with the business team that handles supplier contracts.
* Segment needs. SMBs prepaying by card or UPI, agencies funding many client accounts from one place, and enterprise clients on invoiced terms.
* Revenue metrics. Top-up conversion, payment success rate, time to first funded campaign, wallet balance retention, and reconciliation accuracy. Every revenue number in Accelerate's success framework depends on your system.

**What we're looking for:**

* 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years owning payments, wallets, billing or ledger systems.
* You have built a payments or wallet system from scratch, or led its first major version. Scaling a mature system alone is not enough.
* Deep understanding of double-entry ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation, refunds and chargebacks. You can sit with engineers and discuss failure modes, not just flows.
* Hands-on experience integrating a third-party payment provider or aggregator end to end.
* Working knowledge of Indian payments regulation and tax: RBI rules on prepaid instruments, GST, TDS. You know when to bring in legal and what to ask them.
* You work AI-native (see "How we work" below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
* Clear written communication. You can explain a ledger design to an engineer, a finance controller and an SMB owner, each in their own terms.  
  Strong pluses
* You built a wallet or stored-balance feature inside a non-fintech product, such as a marketplace, mobility, food delivery or SaaS platform.
* Experience with ad-platform billing (prepaid, postpaid or credit-line models) or marketplace payouts.
* Experience with cross-border payments, multi-currency balances or FX.
* Experience with B2B billing for agencies or multi-entity accounts.
* Some time as an engineer, or comfort reading API docs and querying data directly.

**How we work:**  
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

* Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
* Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
* Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
* Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
* Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

title: Sr Staff Technical Product Manager
job_description:
The Analytics & AI Delivery Manager for Sourcing is responsible for defining, owning, and executing the end-to-end data, analytics, and AI product delivery for Power’s Sourcing organization. This leadership role ensures that analytical and AI products are delivered on time, within budget, and to high-quality standards while generating measurable business value.
  
  
Serving as a strategic bridge across executive business stakeholders, Digital Technology, analytics operations, AI Foundry, Power teams, the leader will establish the product vision, define complex business and technical requirements, and translate business priorities into scalable, user-centric Analytics and AI solutions. The role will orchestrate cross-functional delivery, drive adoption and integration into day-to-day operations, and continuously improve product performance across the Sourcing domain.
  
  
As the AI Delivery Leader, this individual will oversee overall AI product delivery—from data readiness assessments and Proof-of-Concept execution through MVP delivery, production deployment, and operational transition. By combining deep business-process understanding with strategic roadmap ownership and disciplined delivery oversight, the leader will ensure that data and AI investments remain aligned with operational priorities, customer needs, and evolving market opportunities.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

In this role, you will:

* **AI Data Readiness and Delivery**: Partner with the AI Strategy Data Science and AI Architecture teams to lead data-readiness activities, technical execution of proofs of concept, MVP development, and the scaling of validated solutions into high-impact, production-grade AI products.

* **AI Strategy and Demand Management:** Partner with the AI Strategy Portfolio team to build and maintain a strong demand pipeline, establish effective intake and prioritization processes, and enable a stable, scalable AI delivery model.

* **Data and Analytics Strategy and Lifecycle Ownership**: Partner with Data Architects to define and execute the end-to-end roadmap for data, analytics, and AI products—from ideation and proof of concept through MVP delivery, production deployment, and ongoing product optimization.

* **Partner and Capacity Management:** Translate demand and priorities from the agile planning process into actionable capacity plans. Lead the Program Increment planning process and work with OCIO and strategic partners to onboard the right resources and capabilities for both analytics and AI delivery.

* **Cross-Functional Leadership**: Serve as the primary liaison among executive stakeholders, Digital Technology, business operations, and delivery partners to align requirements, priorities, and execution with strategic business objectives.

* **Operational Excellence:** Drive simplification, standardization, and delivery rigor by facilitating workshops and implementing improvements across tools, processes, and workflows.

* **Requirements and Backlog Management**: Translate complex business needs into well-defined features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized product backlogs using agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.

* **Data, Risk, and Compliance Governance**: Ensure that all analytics and AI solutions comply with enterprise standards for data quality, architecture, cybersecurity, internal controls, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

* **Standard Work and Platform Optimization**: Establish robust standard work, simplify complex delivery processes, and continuously optimize analytical platforms and operating models for scalability, reliability, and performance.

* **Performance Monitoring and Value Realization**: Define product KPIs, monitor adoption and user feedback, identify performance trends, and drive continuous product enhancements that deliver measurable business outcomes.

* **Automation and Productivity**: Identify opportunities to automate manual activities, improve end-to-end process and data lineage, and partner with enterprise data organizations to increase delivery efficiency and overall team productivity.

  
  

**Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or a STEM-related field, including Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics.

Experience in data management, business intelligence, data analytics, or related discipline.

Technical experience, with demonstrated leadership across multiple functions and disciplines within a product or delivery organization.

Demonstrated success leading at least two significant transformation initiatives, including organizational change management and the delivery of measurable business outcomes.

  

**Desired Characteristics**

  

* **Technical Proficiency:** Demonstrated experience working in Agile and SAFe environments, with strong knowledge of enterprise data and analytics technologies such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, SAP, Oracle, and Databricks. Familiarity with cloud, big data, and AI/ML technologies, including AWS, Python, Spark, and Java, is highly desirable.

* **Business and Domain Expertise:** Strong understanding of Sourcing value streams and the integration of transactional and analytical data to enable actionable insights and measurable business value.

* **AI and Analytics Strategy**: Solid knowledge of data governance, master data management, and the end-to-end AI and machine learning lifecycle, including data readiness, proof-of-concept execution, MVP development, production deployment, and ongoing optimization.

* **Strategic Leadership:** Proven ability to lead transformation, navigate competing priorities, influence senior stakeholders, and translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical business leaders.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high-performing teams and collaborate effectively across Digital Technology, Sourcing and other functional organizations to align product strategy with operational priorities.

* **Governance and Risk Management:** Strong commitment to enterprise standards and controls, including cybersecurity, SOX compliance, data governance, privacy, application controls, and regulatory requirements.

* **Process Improvement:** Experience applying Lean principles, structured problem-solving, and continuous-improvement methodologies to simplify processes, establish standard work, and improve the scalability and performance of the product portfolio.

* **Influential Communication:** Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to mentor and energize teams, establish a shared vision, build alignment, and maintain momentum through complex technical and organizational challenges.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

* **Data, Risk, and Compliance Governance**: Ensure that all analytics and AI solutions comply with enterprise standards for data quality, architecture, cybersecurity, internal controls, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

* **Standard Work and Platform Optimization**: Establish robust standard work, simplify complex delivery processes, and continuously optimize analytical platforms and operating models for scalability, reliability, and performance.

* **Performance Monitoring and Value Realization**: Define product KPIs, monitor adoption and user feedback, identify performance trends, and drive continuous product enhancements that deliver measurable business outcomes.

* **Automation and Productivity**: Identify opportunities to automate manual activities, improve end-to-end process and data lineage, and partner with enterprise data organizations to increase delivery efficiency and overall team productivity.

  
  

**Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or a STEM-related field, including Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics.

Experience in data management, business intelligence, data analytics, or related discipline.

Technical experience, with demonstrated leadership across multiple functions and disciplines within a product or delivery organization.

Demonstrated success leading at least two significant transformation initiatives, including organizational change management and the delivery of measurable business outcomes.

  

**Desired Characteristics**

  

* **Technical Proficiency:** Demonstrated experience working in Agile and SAFe environments, with strong knowledge of enterprise data and analytics technologies such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, SAP, Oracle, and Databricks. Familiarity with cloud, big data, and AI/ML technologies, including AWS, Python, Spark, and Java, is highly desirable.

* **Business and Domain Expertise:** Strong understanding of Sourcing value streams and the integration of transactional and analytical data to enable actionable insights and measurable business value.

* **AI and Analytics Strategy**: Solid knowledge of data governance, master data management, and the end-to-end AI and machine learning lifecycle, including data readiness, proof-of-concept execution, MVP development, production deployment, and ongoing optimization.

* **Strategic Leadership:** Proven ability to lead transformation, navigate competing priorities, influence senior stakeholders, and translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical business leaders.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high-performing teams and collaborate effectively across Digital Technology, Sourcing and other functional organizations to align product strategy with operational priorities.

* **Governance and Risk Management:** Strong commitment to enterprise standards and controls, including cybersecurity, SOX compliance, data governance, privacy, application controls, and regulatory requirements.

* **Process Improvement:** Experience applying Lean principles, structured problem-solving, and continuous-improvement methodologies to simplify processes, establish standard work, and improve the scalability and performance of the product portfolio.

* **Influential Communication:** Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to mentor and energize teams, establish a shared vision, build alignment, and maintain momentum through complex technical and organizational challenges.

author: Hiring Manager
title: AI Product Manager
job_description:
**Who We Are?**

Cleantech Industry Resources accelerates solar, wind, green hydrogen, battery storage, and EV infrastructure projects across the United States, India, and EMEA markets. The company provides turnkey "Development as a Service," powered by 100% internal systems engineering and a world-class team that comes out of some of the most reputed organizations in the renewables industry. This team operates within a sophisticated software and AI environment to support projects from land origination, through to commercial operation.

**Location of Position:**

* Chennai

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to join a top-notch, collaborative team of professionals
* Fantastic team environment and collaborative culture
* Professional development opportunities to grow into an industry leader
* Medical Insurance for the employee and family
* Spot Recognition bonus for exceptional performance
* Long Term Incentive policy
* Regular team outings, events, and activities to foster a positive work environment

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

At CIR, we are dedicated to nurturing a diverse and equitable workforce that truly reflects our community. We deeply value each person’s unique perspective, skills, and experiences. CIR embraces all individuals, regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or nationality. We are steadfast in our commitment to fostering a just and inclusive world through intentional policies and actions. Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for an AI Product Manager to lead cross-functional teams in defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmaps for our AI-powered digital products at scale. The role sits at the intersection of product strategy, applied AI, and renewable energy domain expertise, and will drive the next generation of our internal and market-facing products.

Building on the success of our existing platforms, the AI Product Manager will play a central role in advancing our shift toward agentic, AI-native solutions, translating business objectives and user needs into products that enable smarter automation, faster decision-making, and measurable productivity gains across the organization.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Strategy & Vision:** Define product goals, multi-quarter roadmaps, and go-to-market plans for AI-powered internal tools and customer-facing products, aligned with business objectives and user needs.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Partner with engineering, data science, legal, sales, and domain experts to guide products from ideation to launch through influence rather than direct authority.
* **Data-Driven Iteration:** Analyze user behavior and market trends, design experiments, and iterate rapidly based on post-launch metrics.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Communicate technical and strategic trade-offs to executive leadership and build consensus across departments.
* **Product Discovery & Prioritization:** Identify high-impact AI use cases across engineering, design, project development, and business teams, and translate them into clear product requirements, user stories, and a prioritized backlog.
* **AI Product Definition:** Shape requirements for agentic applications, copilots, and automations for the renewable energy sector, working with engineering to balance model performance, cost, reliability, and user experience.
* **Adoption & Enablement:** Drive adoption of launched products across the organization through onboarding, training, and user feedback loops, and track measurable productivity gains.
* **Responsible AI & Governance:** Work with engineering and legal teams to ensure products meet standards for evaluation, guardrails, data privacy, and governance.
* **Market & Innovation Insight:** Stay current with advancements in AI, agentic tooling, and the renewable energy software landscape, and translate them into actionable product opportunities for the company.

**Educational and Technical Skills**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, business, or a related field; an MBA is a plus.
* Any additional credentials that reflect an ability to operate out of the box such as having background in finance, operations, strategy will be considered a plus

**Preferred Skills**

**Product Management Proficiency:**

* Proven experience as a Product Manager owning digital or AI/ML-powered products from concept through launch and scale.
* Demonstrated ability to define product vision, build multi-quarter roadmaps, and deliver go-to-market plans.
* Strong working knowledge of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts (LLMs, RAG, agents, evaluation) sufficient to make informed trade-offs with engineering teams.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, design, legal, and sales through influence rather than direct authority.
* Proficiency in product analytics and experimentation: defining KPIs, running A/B tests, and using tools such as SQL, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Power BI.
* Experience with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership.

**Renewable Energy Systems:**

* Understanding of solar energy systems and their integration into existing infrastructure

**Experience**

* Prior experience building products for the renewable energy, power, or infrastructure sectors.
* Familiarity with solar PV concepts, energy modeling, GIS data, or techno-commercial analysis.
* Experience launching AI copilots, chat interfaces, or workflow automation tools for internal or enterprise users.
* Experience with B2B or enterprise SaaS products, including pricing, packaging, and go-to-market.
* Track record of using user research and post-launch metrics to drive product iteration.
* Exposure to MLOps / LLMOps concepts such as model evaluation, observability, and continuous improvement.

**Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills**

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ideas and run with them from concept to conclusion.
* Technical understanding of clean energy business processes
* Exceptional verbal and writing communication skills with superiors, peers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build consensus and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The physical demands of this job require an individual to be able to work at a computer for most of the day, be able to participate in conference calls and travel to team retreats on a time-to-time basis. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Work Conditions**

The work environment is usually quiet (normal city traffic noises are common), a blend of artificial and natural light, temperate and generally supports a collaborative work environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

At Cleantech Industry Resources, we embrace diversity and uphold a strong dedication to establishing an all-encompassing atmosphere for both our staff and associates. Our choices in employment are free from any bias related to race, creed, nationality, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, physical limitations, veteran status, or any other legally safeguarded attributes.

Being an integral part of Cleantech Industry Resources means you can expect to be immersed in a realm of professional possibilities within a culture that nurtures teamwork, adaptability, and the embracing of all.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Partner with engineering, data science, legal, sales, and domain experts to guide products from ideation to launch through influence rather than direct authority.
* **Data-Driven Iteration:** Analyze user behavior and market trends, design experiments, and iterate rapidly based on post-launch metrics.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Communicate technical and strategic trade-offs to executive leadership and build consensus across departments.
* **Product Discovery & Prioritization:** Identify high-impact AI use cases across engineering, design, project development, and business teams, and translate them into clear product requirements, user stories, and a prioritized backlog.
* **AI Product Definition:** Shape requirements for agentic applications, copilots, and automations for the renewable energy sector, working with engineering to balance model performance, cost, reliability, and user experience.
* **Adoption & Enablement:** Drive adoption of launched products across the organization through onboarding, training, and user feedback loops, and track measurable productivity gains.
* **Responsible AI & Governance:** Work with engineering and legal teams to ensure products meet standards for evaluation, guardrails, data privacy, and governance.
* **Market & Innovation Insight:** Stay current with advancements in AI, agentic tooling, and the renewable energy software landscape, and translate them into actionable product opportunities for the company.

**Educational and Technical Skills**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, business, or a related field; an MBA is a plus.
* Any additional credentials that reflect an ability to operate out of the box such as having background in finance, operations, strategy will be considered a plus

**Preferred Skills**

**Product Management Proficiency:**

* Proven experience as a Product Manager owning digital or AI/ML-powered products from concept through launch and scale.
* Demonstrated ability to define product vision, build multi-quarter roadmaps, and deliver go-to-market plans.
* Strong working knowledge of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts (LLMs, RAG, agents, evaluation) sufficient to make informed trade-offs with engineering teams.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, design, legal, and sales through influence rather than direct authority.
* Proficiency in product analytics and experimentation: defining KPIs, running A/B tests, and using tools such as SQL, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Power BI.
* Experience with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership.

**Renewable Energy Systems:**

* Understanding of solar energy systems and their integration into existing infrastructure

**Experience**

* Prior experience building products for the renewable energy, power, or infrastructure sectors.
* Familiarity with solar PV concepts, energy modeling, GIS data, or techno-commercial analysis.
* Experience launching AI copilots, chat interfaces, or workflow automation tools for internal or enterprise users.
* Experience with B2B or enterprise SaaS products, including pricing, packaging, and go-to-market.
* Track record of using user research and post-launch metrics to drive product iteration.
* Exposure to MLOps / LLMOps concepts such as model evaluation, observability, and continuous improvement.

**Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills**

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ideas and run with them from concept to conclusion.
* Technical understanding of clean energy business processes
* Exceptional verbal and writing communication skills with superiors, peers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build consensus and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. title: Product Manager
job_description:
We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who is passionate about building digital products which customers love. You will join a dynamic and fast-paced environment and work with cross-functional teams to design, build and roll-out products that deliver the company’s vision and strategy.
  
  
You are currently working on a flexible work arrangement and you are interested to take on more work which can be fulfilling and eventually convert into a rewarding full-time role.
  
  
Absolutely critical is your past experience in managing & understanding the engineering time taken to develop many features and then breaking that into multiple daily sprint batches. We use agile methodology and there are no sprints which last more than 2 weeks with testing time included.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
  
  

* We are looking for someone who can work across the entire product development cycle; customer research, UX discovery, hypothesis definition, wireframing, sprint planning, project management and product marketing.
* 3+ years of experience in software product management
* Creating buy-in for our product vision both internally and with key external partners
* Translating product strategy into simplistic, detailed requirements and prototypes
* Co-ordinate information received between emails, WhatsApp voice messages & calls, competitor platforms, stakeholders of all levels and so much more
* Developer’s Time Management
* Ensure Crystal Clarity in sprint tasks
* Test completed sprints
* Drive a Project Management Platform’s usage
* Traffic Light Sprints in order of business value
* Gain a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth
* Scope and prioritize activities based on business and customer impact
* Work closely with the engineering team to deliver quick time-to-market by optimizing resources
* Act as a product evangelist to build awareness and understanding across the business to all stakeholders, internal & external
* Represent the company by talking to customers to solicit feedback on company products and services
* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager
* Well versed with agile software development methodologies
* Some technical background with understanding and/or hands-on experience in software development and web technologies
* Excellent English is very important, written and verbal communication skills
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to think outside the box and roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done

  
Working Hours
  

* Flexible time, remote working, 20 hrs per week minimum to be committed

title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**Why Work Here**

* Headquarters is in Charlotte, NC
* Recently expanded to nearshore
* isolved ranked for SMB Payroll in 2023 Sapient Report
* Voted top places to work in USA 2023

**Job Description**

**Associate Product Manager, Partner Integrations**

**Summary/objective**

isolved connects its HR, payroll, and benefits platform to a growing network of strategic partners. Our partners make products for areas such as benefits brokerage, earned wage access, retirement, and compliance. In this role you will work every day from our Hyderabad office with the engineering teams that build and support these partner integrations. You will make sure each integration is clearly specified, well tested, launched smoothly, and monitored once it is live.

You will be the product voice for these teams during the India workday. You will turn partner requirements into work that is ready to build, answer questions quickly, and look for ways to make each new integration faster and more consistent than the last. You will work closely with US-based product leadership, and the role requires regular overlap with US business hours for handoffs,

**Core Job Duties**

* Write integration specifications covering data mapping, sync direction and frequency, error handling, and API dependencies
* Own backlog refinement and sprint readiness for several integration development teams
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that engineering and QA can build and test against
* Define and run the launch checklist for each partner: certification testing, user acceptance testing, go-live readiness, and monitoring and alerts
* Spot patterns across partner integrations and push for reusable components instead of one-off builds
* Keep roadmap items current in our planning tools (Airfocus, Azure DevOps), including status, health, and risks
* Maintain known-issues and support documentation for live integrations
* Work with US-based product managers, partner teams, architecture, and support across time zones, through overlapping meetings and a daily written handoff

**Job Complexity**

A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Emerging understanding of broader organizational context and goals. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented, journey-level position

**Interaction**

Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise

**Supervision**

Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments.

**Experience**

Typically requires a minimum of 6–8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or equivalent work experience.

**Scope**

N/A

**Discretion**

N/A

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 6+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in business analysis or a related technical role with direct involvement in defining requirements and working with engineering teams
* Experience working with REST APIs and webhooks, and comfort reading API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger)
* Experience with data mapping between systems
* Strong user story and acceptance criteria writing in an Agile/Scrum environment
* Clear written English. Much of the collaboration with US teams happens in writing.
* Availability for regular overlap with US business hours
* A sense of ownership: you follow problems through to resolution without waiting to be asked

**Preferred Qualfication**

* Experience with an integration platform (iPaaS) such as Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, or similar
* Hands-on API testing with Postman or similar tools
* Domain knowledge in HR, payroll, or benefits software
* Experience working with distributed teams across time zones
* Experience using AI tools such as Claude to speed up requirements, analysis, or documentation work

**Physical Demands**

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds.

**Travel Required**

No

**FLSA Classification**

Exempt

**Location**

Nearshore/Hyderabad

**Effective** **Date:** 1/1/2023

**Internal Job Title**
======================

Associate Product Manager, Partner Integrations

**About isolved**
=================

isolved is an employee experience leader, providing intuitive, people-first HCM (Human Capital Management) technology. Our solutions are delivered directly or through our partner network to more than five million employees and 145,000 employers - who use them every day to boost performance, increase productivity, and accelerate results while reducing risk. Our HCM platform, isolved People Cloud, seamlessly connects and manages the employee journey across talent management, HRpayroll, workforce management and engagement management functions. No matter the industry, we help high-growth organizations employ, enable and empower their workforce by transforming employee experience for a better today and a better tomorrow. For more information, visit www.isolvedhcm.com.

isolved is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. isolved is a progressive and open-minded meritocracy. If you are smart and good at what you do, come as you are. Visit www.isolvedhcm.com/careers for more information regarding our incredible culture and focus on our employee experience. Visit www.isolvedeebenefits.com for a comprehensive list of our employee total rewards offerings.

title: Deputy IT Product Owner - SAP Production to Stock ( P2S)
job_description:
**Company Description**

**Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited** is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced SAP P2S Senior Consultant for the deputy IT PO role. The role will lead the P2S team and be responsible for delivering P2S continuous development business requirements for SAP R/3 & S4 HANA. It requires strong Production execution domain knowledge, proven experience in both SAP R/3 and S4 technologies, expertise in repetitive manufacturing, interfaces – SOAP, OData, Idoc, RFC. process.

**Roles & Responsibility :**

* You are leading a team of experienced IT consultants and developers and actively develop the team to work in an agile organization.
* Furthermore, you actively participate in the process design, keep focus on technical aspects, drive re-usability and the usage of SAP Standard.
* Cross-functional integration with SAP PP- WM/EWM, ePPDS, QM, SD.
* You will consult User Department and Governance Functions in all P2S related questions and align dependencies with adjoining process areas.
* You will conduct the Product Lifecycle Management for your process chain, incl. Design & Build, Rollout, Support & Maintenance.
* Additionally, you are an active part of the development team, identifying dependencies or constraints and prioritizing the backlog refinement
* Collaborating with other IT Product Development Teams and Chief Product Owners to identify synergies and drive standardization will be one of your tasks.
* You address cross-team prioritization conflicts and drive resolution with other Product Owners.
* As a deputy product owner you define the team set-up within E2E process, identify required competencies and ensure staffing.

**Experience :**

Minimum 10 years’ experience in design/ implementation/ consulting in P2S , experience in

**Mandatory/requires Skills :**  
Expertise in repetitive manufacturing & interfaces

Expertise inproduction IT applications,SAP R/3 & S/4 HANA in Production Planning & execution, Knowledge in Solution Manager & Jira Tool

**Preferred Skills :**  
Certification in Supply Chain Management & Agile methodology

 **Qualifications**

**Educational qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree in engineering / IT / or related field
